summary: Anonymous device "01a1ab3e-58a5-7c98-b771-57bc919c37e7": 2 events in 90 days, 1 recorded sessions.
sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1786098541613
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793874601613
)
SELECT event, ts_ms, path, session_id, props FROM ev WHERE pid = '01a1ab3e-58a5-7c98-b771-57bc919c37e7' OR distinct_id = '01a1ab3e-58a5-7c98-b771-57bc919c37e7'
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 100
